description: This file implements a thread-safe string atomization system with a global shared state, including a custom hash table, slab allocator, and thread-local caching for efficient string deduplication and lookup.

classes.name: StringAtomSet
classes.description: Manages a global set of unique string pointers with thread-safe access and slab allocation.

classes.name: ThreadLocalCache
classes.description: Provides thread-local caching of string pointer lookups to improve performance.

methods.name: StringAtom::StringAtom
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to empty string.

methods.name: StringAtom::StringAtom(std::string_view)
methods.description: Constructs a StringAtom by finding or creating a unique string pointer for the given string view.
